en.headline: FEHD arrests 14 unlicensed hawkers and seizes nearly 600 kg of food
en.dek: An intelligence-led citywide operation that began on 17 July targeted high-risk locations; suspects aged 38 to 74 face charges including obstruction and selling restricted food.
body: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department said 14 unlicensed hawkers had been arrested and charged in connection with the illegal sale of food during an intelligence-led operation codenamed Dawn Net that started on 17 July and continued through late July.

Officers seized nearly 600 kilograms of food items including shellfish, milk and expired products. All but one of the suspects, aged between 38 and 74, were also charged with obstructing public places; two faced an additional charge of selling restricted food without permission.

Chief Health Inspector (Hawker) Chan Sze-man said the department maintains a zero-tolerance approach, including immediate arrest without prior warning, toward the sale by unlicensed hawkers of food from unknown sources, expired food or prohibited or restricted high-risk items. Three of the arrests took place near a footbridge on Tong Mi Road in Mong Kok, where about 83 kg of food was seized, according to Senior Health Inspector (Hawker) Yuen Chiu-kit.
The department reminded the public not to patronise unlicensed hawkers and to report suspicious activity.

zh.headline: 食環署拘14名無牌小販檢獲近600公斤食品
zh.dek: 由7月17日起展開的情報主導全港行動針對高風險地點，涉案者年齡38至74歲，大部分另被控阻街，兩人兼控售賣限制售賣食物。
body: 食物環境衞生署表示，在代號「黎明網」的情報主導全港行動中，已拘捕並起訴14名涉嫌非法售賣食品的無牌小販。行動自7月17日展開，持續至7月下旬，針對高風險地點及可疑活動。
人員檢獲近600公斤食品，包括貝殼類、奶類及過期食品。涉案者年齡介乎38至74歲，除一人外全部另被控在公眾地方造成阻礙；其中兩人兼控未經准許售賣限制售賣食物。
總監（小販）陳思敏表示，署方對無牌小販售賣來源不明、過期、禁止或限制的高風險食品採取零容忍態度，包括即時拘捕而不作事先警告。旺角塘尾道天橋附近有三宗拘捕，檢獲約83公斤食品，由旺角區高級衛生督察（小販）袁昭傑交代。
署方呼籲市民不要光顧無牌小販，並舉報可疑活動。
